titleZh: ProME：用于群体鲁棒学习的原型边际环境与修复感知选择
titleEn: ProME: Prototype-Margin Environments with Repair-Aware Selection for Group-Robust Learning
summaryZh: ProME 将无训练群体标签的群体鲁棒学习表述为“内生环境与修复感知选择”问题：沿同一表示学习轨迹用原型边际构造环境，再以修复后的分类器评价并选择最终部署模型。
summaryEn: ProME formulates group-robust learning without training-group labels as endogenous environments with repair-aware selection: prototype margins construct environments along the representation trajectory, and repaired classifiers determine which predictor is deployed.
coverAltZh: ProME 论文中的两阶段训练、分类器修复与部署流程图
coverAltEn: The two-stage ProME training, classifier-repair and deployment framework from the paper

blocks.zh: 论文由 Qianqian Wang、Yunshan Li、Dawei Huang、Wenwu Gong 与 Lili Yang 完成，作者来自南方科技大学统计与数据科学系及深圳市下一代工业互联网安全技术重点实验室。arXiv v1 于 2026 年 8 月 13 日提交。
blocks.en: The paper is authored by Qianqian Wang, Yunshan Li, Dawei Huang, Wenwu Gong and Lili Yang from the Department of Statistics and Data Science at Southern University of Science and Technology and the Shenzhen Key Laboratory of Safety and Security for Next Generation of Industrial Internet. arXiv v1 was submitted on 13 August 2026.

blocks.zh: 群体鲁棒学习关注最弱子群体的性能。训练数据中的稀有群体占比很低时，经验风险最小化可能依赖背景、性别或颜色等捷径特征，在总体准确率较高的同时留下很低的最差群体准确率（WGA）。完整标注每个训练样本的群体身份通常代价高昂，因此本文研究在训练阶段没有群体标签时如何构造有效环境并选择最终预测器。
blocks.en: Group-robust learning protects the weakest subpopulation. When rare groups are underrepresented, empirical risk minimization can rely on shortcuts such as background, gender or colour, producing strong average accuracy but poor worst-group accuracy (WGA). Because annotating every training example with a group identity is often impractical, the paper asks how to construct useful environments and select a deployable predictor without training-group labels.

blocks.zh: 两个部署错位
blocks.en: Two deployment misalignments

items.zh: 环境—表示错位：已有流程常用独立参考模型推断固定环境，再训练另一个表示；环境不再跟随正在优化的表示。
items.en: Environment–representation mismatch: a detached reference model often infers a fixed partition for a different representation trained later.

items.zh: 修复前选择错位：某个编码器的原始分类头可能表现不佳，但在最后一层修复后反而最好；按修复前 WGA 或最后检查点选择会丢掉它。
items.en: Pre-repair selection mismatch: an encoder with a weak original head may become the best candidate after last-layer repair, so pre-repair WGA or the final checkpoint can select the wrong model.

blocks.zh: 为同时处理这两种错位，论文提出 ERAS（Endogenous Environments with Repair-Aware Selection）：环境必须来自随后被其正则化的同一训练轨迹，候选模型必须在装上与部署一致的修复分类头之后再比较。
blocks.en: To address both mismatches, the paper introduces ERAS—Endogenous Environments with Repair-Aware Selection. Environments must come from the same trajectory they later regularize, and candidates must be compared only after receiving the repaired classifier used for deployment.

sections.headingZh: 阶段一：原型边际环境学习

blocks.zh: ProME 先用余弦原型分类器完成 ERM 预热。归一化表示的每个类别由其平均表示形成类别原型；预测方向与两个类别原型之差一致。原型会按固定间隔由当前表示重新计算，但本身不参与梯度更新。
blocks.en: ProME begins with an ERM warm-up using a cosine-prototype classifier. Each class prototype is the normalised mean of its representations, and the prediction direction follows the contrast between the two class prototypes. Prototypes are periodically recomputed from the current representation but are not gradient-updated parameters.

blocks.zh: 原型边际
blocks.en: Prototype margin

blocks.code: s(x; y) = cos(phi(x), mu_y) - cos(phi(x), mu_(1-y))

blocks.zh: 这个分数衡量样本表示对真实类别原型的相对支持。边际越小，类别支持越弱或越冲突。ProME 在整个训练集上用边际中位数切分出低边际和高边际两个近似平衡的环境，不需要预先知道真实群体比例。
blocks.en: This score measures how strongly the representation supports the observed class relative to its competitor. A smaller margin indicates weaker or conflicting class support. A global median split creates approximately balanced low- and high-margin environments without assuming the true group proportions.

blocks.zh: 在推断环境上，阶段一同时最小化平均环境风险、IRMv1 梯度惩罚与 REx 风险方差惩罚。标准 ProME 在预热后固定一次分区；ProME-Refresh 则在原型刷新时重新计算分区。两者使用相同目标，只在分区更新频率上不同。训练过程中按里程碑保留编码器检查点，并加入修复前验证 WGA 最好的检查点，形成候选集合。
blocks.en: Across the inferred environments, Stage 1 minimises mean environment risk together with IRMv1 and REx penalties. Standard ProME fixes the post-warm-up partition, whereas ProME-Refresh recomputes it whenever prototypes are refreshed. Both use the same objective and differ only in update frequency. Milestone encoders and the checkpoint with the best pre-repair validation WGA form the candidate pool.

sections.headingZh: 阶段二：分类器修复与候选选择
sections.headingEn: Stage 2: classifier repair and candidate selection

blocks.zh: 对每个候选编码器，ProME 丢弃阶段一的投影层和原型分类头，冻结编码器，并在带群体标注的验证集上拟合一个群体平衡的线性 DFR 分类头。各验证群体在目标函数中权重相同，L2 正则强度通过五折交叉验证选择。
blocks.en: For every candidate encoder, ProME removes the Stage 1 projection and prototype head, freezes the encoder, and fits a group-balanced linear DFR head on group-annotated validation data. Every validation group receives equal weight, and five-fold cross-validation chooses the L2 regularisation strength.

items.zh: 冻结每个候选编码器。
items.en: Freeze each candidate encoder.

items.zh: 为每个候选独立拟合同一族的群体平衡线性分类头。
items.en: Fit the same family of group-balanced linear heads independently for every candidate.

items.zh: 用修复后的验证 WGA 对编码器—分类头组合排序。
items.en: Rank the repaired encoder–head pairs by validation WGA.

items.zh: 只部署得分最高的一对模型；候选搜索全部离线完成。
items.en: Deploy only the highest-scoring pair; candidate search remains offline.

blocks.zh: 阶段一的表示学习不使用训练群体标签。带群体标注的验证数据用于候选跟踪、分类头拟合、正则调参与最终选择，但不反向更新阶段一表示。测试群体标签只用于报告 WGA，不参与预测或选择。
blocks.en: Stage 1 representation learning uses no training-group labels. Group-annotated validation data support candidate tracking, head fitting, regularisation tuning and final selection, but do not update the Stage 1 representation. Test-group labels are used only to report WGA, never for prediction or selection.

items.zh: 原型边际恒等式：在二分类设定下，边际与训练分类器的 logit 共享同一条线性方向。
items.en: Prototype-margin identity: in the binary setting, the margin and the training logit share the same linear direction.

items.zh: 捷径冲突分离：在论文给出的因果—捷径正交分解、正系数与有界投影噪声条件下，捷径冲突样本具有更低边际；当冲突样本不超过一半时，中位数低边际单元会富集这些样本。
items.en: Shortcut-conflict separation: under the paper's causal–shortcut decomposition, positive coefficients and bounded projected noise, shortcut-conflicting samples receive smaller margins; when they are at most half the data, the median low-margin cell enriches them.

items.zh: 内生分区稳定性：当表示发生有界变化时，原型、边际和中位数也有界变化，只有原中位数附近的样本可能切换环境。
items.en: Endogenous-partition stability: bounded representation changes induce bounded changes in prototypes, margins and the median, so only samples near the former median can switch environments.

items.zh: 风险控制：固定预测器和 K 个推断环境时，最坏环境风险不超过平均风险加上 sqrt((K - 1) × REx)。若每个真实群体都与某个推断环境满足总变差距离不超过 rho，边界再增加 B × rho 后可转移到真实群体。
items.en: Risk control: for a fixed predictor and K inferred environments, worst-environment risk is at most mean risk plus sqrt((K - 1) × REx). If every oracle group lies within total-variation distance rho of a matched inferred cell, adding B × rho transfers the bound to oracle groups.

blocks.zh: 这些结论都带有明确条件。论文特别说明：理论没有声称有限样本下从经验风险到总体风险的保证；总变差转移结论也是条件性的。阶段二的修复感知选择主要由实验验证。
blocks.en: These statements are conditional. The paper explicitly does not claim a finite-sample empirical-to-population guarantee, and the total-variation transfer is conditional as well. Repair-aware selection in Stage 2 is supported primarily by experiments.

blocks.zh: 实验覆盖 Waterbirds（鸟类与背景）、CelebA（金发与性别）、CivilComments（毒性与身份子群体）以及受控的 ColoredMNIST（数字奇偶与颜色捷径）。前两个视觉数据集使用 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet-50，CivilComments 使用 BERT-base-uncased，ColoredMNIST 使用三层卷积网络。
blocks.en: Experiments cover Waterbirds (bird type and background), CelebA (blond hair and gender), CivilComments (toxicity across identity subpopulations), and controlled ColoredMNIST (digit parity and a colour shortcut). The visual datasets use ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50, CivilComments uses BERT-base-uncased, and ColoredMNIST uses a three-layer convolutional network.

blocks.zh: 总体比较
blocks.en: Headline comparison

blocks.zh: 在与 ProME 具有相同群体标签访问级别——验证群体标签用于分类器拟合和选择——的方法中，ProME 在 Waterbirds、CelebA、CivilComments 上分别报告 93.1±0.3%、89.3±0.5% 与 78.7±0.2% 的 WGA，三者未加权平均为 87.0%。表中同访问级别最强基线 GSR 的平均值为 83.9%，差 3.1 个百分点。
blocks.en: Among methods with the same group-label access—validation groups used for classifier fitting and selection—ProME reports WGA of 93.1±0.3% on Waterbirds, 89.3±0.5% on CelebA and 78.7±0.2% on CivilComments, for an unweighted average of 87.0%. GSR, the strongest baseline at that access level in the table, averages 83.9%, a 3.1-point difference.

blocks.zh: 这张主表引用各基线原论文的原始协议，因此属于已发表结果的横向报告，而不是完全统一设置下的受控复现。论文随后用匹配设置检验两个对齐机制。
blocks.en: The headline table takes baseline entries from their published protocols, so it is a reported cross-protocol comparison rather than a fully controlled reproduction. The paper then uses matched settings to test the two alignment mechanisms.

blocks.zh: 机制分析
blocks.en: Mechanism analyses

items.zh: Waterbirds 全局中位数分区中，捷径冲突样本占低边际环境的 0.68、占高边际环境的 0.01。
items.en: Under the Waterbirds global-median split, shortcut-conflicting examples make up 0.68 of the low-margin environment and 0.01 of the high-margin environment.

items.zh: 在匹配的分区来源比较中，轨迹实时边际将修复前 WGA 从冻结参考模型的 68.95±3.39% 提高到 78.85±3.56%；经过匹配修复后，两者分别为 90.34±1.75% 与 90.60±0.95%。
items.en: In the matched source comparison, live trajectory margins raise pre-repair WGA from 68.95±3.39% for a frozen reference to 78.85±3.56%; after matched repair, the two finish at 90.34±1.75% and 90.60±0.95%.

items.zh: 分类器修复显著重排候选：Waterbirds 四个阶段一变体的跨度从修复前 12.20 点收窄到修复后 1.25 点；CivilComments 从 9.98 点收窄到 0.34 点。
items.en: Classifier repair substantially reshapes candidate evaluation: the spread across four Stage 1 variants contracts from 12.20 to 1.25 points on Waterbirds and from 9.98 to 0.34 points on CivilComments.

items.zh: CelebA 上，修复后单检查点为 86.94%，里程碑候选池为 89.31%，随机候选池为 89.87%，说明多候选修复后选择优于固定单检查点。
items.en: On CelebA, post-repair WGA is 86.94% for a single checkpoint, 89.31% for milestone candidates and 89.87% for random candidates, showing the value of selecting across multiple repaired candidates.

sections.headingZh: 结论、监督预算与复现说明

blocks.zh: ProME 的核心设计原则是让训练环境与正在学习的表示同轨，让模型选择与真正部署的修复预测器同口径。它不需要训练群体标签，候选搜索离线完成，线上只部署一个编码器和一个线性分类头；但它并非完全不使用群体监督，因为阶段二明确需要带群体标注的验证集。
blocks.en: ProME's central design principle is to align training environments with the representation trajectory and model selection with the repaired predictor that is actually deployed. It needs no training-group labels, performs candidate search offline, and deploys one encoder with one linear head; it is not fully group-label-free, because Stage 2 explicitly requires group-annotated validation data.

blocks.zh: 验证群体标签的价值与少数群体支持量有关：在最小训练群体仅 56 个样本的 Waterbirds 上，使用验证群体数据修复比使用训练群体数据高 18.68 点；CelebA 最小群体有 1,387 个样本，差距为 1.83 点。三项真实数据集在固定十个随机种子下的 WGA 标准差为 0.62、0.51 与 0.30 点，但 ColoredMNIST 的标准差为 5.48 点，因此论文只对真实数据集给出种子稳定性结论。
blocks.en: The value of validation-group labels depends on minority support. On Waterbirds, whose smallest training group has only 56 examples, validation-based repair is 18.68 points above training-based repair; on CelebA, whose smallest group has 1,387 examples, the gap is 1.83 points. Across ten fixed seeds, WGA standard deviations are 0.62, 0.51 and 0.30 points on the three real-world datasets, but 5.48 points on ColoredMNIST, so the paper limits its seed-stability conclusion to the real-world benchmarks.

blocks.zh: 论文声明三个真实数据集来自公开来源，ColoredMNIST 按文中协议由 MNIST 生成；代码将在论文被接收后公开。当前页面因此只链接已公开的 arXiv 原文，不虚构尚未发布的代码仓库。
blocks.en: The paper states that the three real-world datasets are publicly available and that ColoredMNIST is generated from MNIST under its protocol. The code will be made public upon acceptance. This page therefore links only the available arXiv paper and does not invent an unreleased repository.

summaryZh: 以内容驱动的六阶段工作流，把需求澄清、调研、大纲、策划稿和 SVG 设计稿逐步转化为可继续编辑的 PPTX。
summaryEn: A content-driven six-stage workflow that turns discovery, research, outlining, planning and SVG design into an editable PPTX.
coverAltZh: PPT-Agent 页面渲染与 AI 输出日志界面
coverAltEn: PPT-Agent page rendering and AI output log interface

blocks.zh: 内容驱动，而非模板驱动
blocks.en: Content-driven, not template-driven

blocks.zh: 传统 PPT 生成工具经常从主题直接跳到成品页面，用固定模板填充内容，缺少中间审核环节；结果容易空洞、缺乏逻辑，而且最终页面通常只能作为图片或 PDF 使用，后期修改困难。
blocks.en: Conventional PPT generators often jump straight from a topic to finished slides, fill fixed templates and omit meaningful review stages. The result can be hollow, weakly structured and difficult to edit beyond a static image or PDF.

items.zh: 分阶段渐进式生成
items.en: Generate progressively in explicit stages

items.zh: 每个阶段都有明确交付物
items.en: Produce a concrete deliverable at every stage

items.zh: 用户可以在关键节点介入审核
items.en: Let the user review every important decision

items.zh: 由内容决定布局，而不是由模板决定内容
items.en: Let content determine layout rather than the reverse

items.zh: 使用 SVG 作为设计稿中间格式
items.en: Use SVG as the intermediate design representation

items.zh: 把 SVG 转换为 PowerPoint 原生对象，导出可编辑 PPTX
items.en: Convert SVG into native PowerPoint objects and export an editable PPTX

blocks.zh: 模拟专业团队的工作流
blocks.en: A workflow modelled on a professional team

blocks.zh: 完整工作流是：需求澄清 → 资料调研 → 大纲规划 → 策划稿 → SVG 设计稿 → 可编辑 PPTX → 复核。
blocks.en: The complete workflow is: requirements → research → outline → planning draft → SVG design → editable PPTX → review.

blocks.zh: Stage 1：访谈阶段
blocks.en: Stage 1: Interview

blocks.zh: 目标是通过多轮对话深度理解用户需求，并生成后续阶段可以直接使用的调研底稿。
blocks.en: The goal is to understand the user through multiple rounds of conversation and produce a research brief that later stages can use directly.

items.zh: Step 1.0：广度搜索
items.en: Step 1.0: Broad search

items.zh: Step 1.1：第一轮追问，锁定场景与受众
items.en: Step 1.1: First follow-up to identify the setting and audience

items.zh: Step 1.2：深度搜索
items.en: Step 1.2: Deep search

items.zh: Step 1.3：第二轮追问，挖掘核心亮点
items.en: Step 1.3: Second follow-up to uncover the strongest angle

items.zh: Step 1.4：第三轮追问，框定边界与约束
items.en: Step 1.4: Third follow-up to define boundaries and constraints

items.zh: Step 1.5：生成调研底稿
items.en: Step 1.5: Produce the research brief

blocks.zh: 广度搜索的结构化输出
blocks.en: Structured output from broad search

blocks.code:
{
  "topic_summary": "主题一句话概括",
  "typical_scenes": ["场景1", "场景2"],
  "typical_audiences": ["受众1", "受众2"],
  "common_sections": ["板块1", "板块2"],
  "typical_styles": ["风格1", "风格2"]
}

blocks.zh: 第一轮追问 Prompt
blocks.en: Prompt for the first follow-up

blocks.code:
- 语气自然亲切，像真人对话，不要列表式提问
- 先简短回应用户主题，再抛出有引导性的问题
- 问题要具体，给出 2-3 个方向让用户容易回答
- 一次只问一个核心问题

blocks.zh: 深度搜索的结构化输出
blocks.en: Structured output from deep search

blocks.zh: 第二轮追问根据深度调研结果给出具体亮点方向，帮助用户把模糊想法变成明确意图；第三轮继续确认时长、页数、已有素材、必须包含或避免的内容、视觉偏好和特殊要求。
blocks.en: The second follow-up turns research into concrete directions that help the user clarify a vague idea. The third confirms duration, page count, available assets, required or forbidden content, visual preferences and special constraints.

blocks.zh: 访谈阶段采用“搜索 → 追问 → 再搜索 → 再追问”的循环，从宽到窄逐步收集信息，并以结构化数据保存中间结果，为用户减轻表达负担。
blocks.en: The interview follows a search → question → deeper search → question loop. It narrows the problem progressively, stores intermediate results as structured data and reduces the user’s effort.

blocks.zh: Stage 2：调研底稿阶段
blocks.en: Stage 2: Research brief

blocks.zh: 这一阶段把访谈结果整理成后续生成可直接使用的调研底稿（research_brief）。用户既可以修改整体底稿，也可以只修改其中一个部分。
blocks.en: This stage turns the interview into a directly reusable research_brief. The user can revise the whole brief or change only one part.

items.zh: 主题概括、目标受众、演示目的与使用场景
items.en: Topic, audience, purpose and setting

items.zh: 时间与页数要求、核心亮点
items.en: Duration, page count and core highlights

items.zh: 关键事实与证据、推荐章节
items.en: Key facts, evidence and recommended sections

items.zh: 已有素材、风险与信息缺口、建议表达风格
items.en: Available assets, risks, information gaps and recommended style

blocks.zh: Stage 3：大纲阶段
blocks.en: Stage 3: Outline

blocks.zh: 大纲基于调研底稿生成，并把金字塔原理直接写进 Prompt：结论先行、以上统下、归类分组、逻辑递进。
blocks.en: The outline is generated from the research brief with four pyramid-principle rules embedded in the prompt: lead with conclusions, support higher-level ideas, group peers and maintain a clear progression.

items.zh: 每页明确页面标题和页面目标
items.en: Define a title and goal for every slide

items.zh: 列出核心要点
items.en: List the core points

items.zh: 提前建议视觉表达形式
items.en: Recommend a visual treatment in advance

items.zh: 支持整体修改，也支持针对单页调整
items.en: Support both full-outline and single-slide revisions

blocks.zh: Stage 4：策划稿阶段
blocks.en: Stage 4: Planning draft

blocks.zh: 策划稿填补大纲到设计稿之间的信息层。它明确每页最需要观众记住的结论、主次信息、视觉表达、证据建议、布局方向和设计注意事项。
blocks.en: The planning draft fills the gap between an outline and visual design. It defines the key takeaway, information hierarchy, visual treatment, evidence, layout direction and design notes for every slide.

blocks.code:
{
  "page_number": 1,
  "title": "页面标题",
  "goal": "页面最重要的结论",
  "core_messages": ["核心信息1", "核心信息2"],
  "evidence_suggestions": ["证据建议"],
  "visual_type": "推荐表达方式",
  "layout_direction": "布局方向",
  "keywords": ["关键词"],
  "design_notes": "设计注意事项"
}

blocks.zh: Stage 5：SVG 设计稿阶段
blocks.en: Stage 5: SVG design

blocks.zh: 系统把策划卡转化为 1280×720 的规范化 SVG，并在浏览器中直接预览。当前版本不再让 AI 生成 HTML 页面。
blocks.en: The system turns each planning card into a normalized 1280×720 SVG and previews it directly in the browser. The current version no longer asks the AI to generate HTML slides.

items.zh: 支持 svg、g、rect、circle、ellipse、line、text、tspan，以及少量 path、polygon、polyline
items.en: Support svg, g, rect, circle, ellipse, line, text, tspan and limited path, polygon and polyline elements

items.zh: 禁用 foreignObject、image、复杂 CSS、class、图标字体、filter、mask、clipPath、script 与 iframe
items.en: Disallow foreignObject, image, complex CSS, classes, icon fonts, filters, masks, clip paths, scripts and iframes

items.zh: 每个文字块使用独立 text 元素，并提供 data-w 与 data-h
items.en: Represent every text block with its own text element and data-w / data-h bounds

items.zh: 默认使用浅色或白色背景，保持信息层级、视觉秩序与左右平衡
items.en: Prefer light backgrounds with clear hierarchy, visual order and balanced composition

items.zh: 所有可见内容位于安全区，组件不能互相遮挡
items.en: Keep all visible content inside the safe area without component overlap

blocks.zh: AI 生成 SVG 后，程序会提取并清理内容，补充字体和文字边界，把越界文本调整回安全区，检查尺寸和禁用元素，并对硬性错误调用 AI 自动修复。不完整的 SVG 会被要求重新生成。
blocks.en: After generation, the program extracts and sanitizes the SVG, supplies fonts and text bounds, returns overflow to the safe area, checks dimensions and forbidden elements, and asks the AI to repair hard failures. Incomplete SVG output is regenerated.

blocks.zh: Stage 6：导出与项目恢复
blocks.en: Stage 6: Export and project recovery

blocks.zh: 当前版本支持导出可编辑 PPTX、PDF、HTML 预览文件和完整会话文件 .pptagent.json。
blocks.en: The current version exports editable PPTX, PDF, HTML previews and complete .pptagent.json session files.

blocks.zh: 可编辑 PPTX 使用 SVG → PowerPoint 原生 DrawingML 对象 → PPTX 的转换链路。rect 转换为矩形或圆角矩形，circle / ellipse 转换为椭圆，line 转换为原生线条，path / polygon / polyline 转换为自定义几何，text / tspan 转换为原生文本框。
blocks.en: Editable PPTX export follows SVG → native PowerPoint DrawingML → PPTX. Rectangles, ellipses, lines, paths and text are converted into their corresponding editable PowerPoint objects.

blocks.zh: 完整会话会保存访谈消息、调研底稿、大纲、策划稿、已生成的 SVG 页面和当前工作流阶段，用户可以下次导入并继续修改。
blocks.en: A complete session stores interview messages, research brief, outline, planning draft, generated SVG pages and current workflow stage so the project can be restored and edited later.

sections.headingZh: 第一版与当前版本的区别
sections.headingEn: From the first version to the current version

items.zh: 从策划稿直接生成 HTML，改为生成规范化 SVG，再转换为 DrawingML 和可编辑 PPTX
items.en: Replace direct HTML generation with normalized SVG, DrawingML conversion and editable PPTX export

items.zh: 新增可编辑 PPTX 导出
items.en: Add editable PPTX export

items.zh: 浏览器预览和 PowerPoint 导出统一使用同一份 SVG，保证所见即所得
items.en: Use the same SVG for browser preview and PowerPoint export to preserve what-you-see-is-what-you-get

items.zh: 从主要依赖 Prompt，升级为 Prompt 引导、程序规范化、SVG 校验和 AI 自动修复共同保障
items.en: Combine prompt guidance with program normalization, SVG validation and AI repair

items.zh: 优化用户与系统的交互逻辑，让右侧栏及时反馈操作状态
items.en: Improve interaction and provide timely status feedback in the right panel

items.zh: 优化 PPT-Agent 的整体美学设计
items.en: Refine PPT-Agent’s visual design

items.zh: 优化网页前端界面设计
items.en: Refine the web interface

items.zh: 优化输入框输入逻辑
items.en: Improve input behaviour

items.zh: 新增欢迎界面、项目导入与 .pptagent.json 完整会话导出
items.en: Add a welcome screen, project import and complete .pptagent.json session export

items.zh: 分阶段工作流：渐进构建、明确交付物与审核点，并允许随时返回已完成阶段修改
items.en: Staged workflow with progressive construction, explicit deliverables, review points and reversible stages

items.zh: 策划稿中间层：明确每页核心结论、信息层级和视觉表达
items.en: A planning layer that defines each slide’s conclusion, hierarchy and visual treatment

items.zh: 搜索与追问循环：AI 先建立背景，再从宽到窄理解用户真实意图
items.en: A search-and-question loop that narrows from background knowledge to the user’s real intent

items.zh: SVG 设计中间表示：可以预览、检查、修复并转换为 PowerPoint 原生对象
items.en: SVG as an intermediate representation that can be previewed, checked, repaired and converted to native PowerPoint objects

items.zh: SVG 转 DrawingML 和可编辑 PPTX：不依赖整页截图，文字和主要图形可以继续编辑
items.en: SVG-to-DrawingML conversion that preserves editable text and shapes instead of flattening each slide

items.zh: Prompt 与程序校验结合：Prompt 负责方向，程序负责规范化、边界检查与修复
items.en: Prompt guidance combined with deterministic normalization, boundary checks and repair

items.zh: 多层次修改：支持整体修改、单页修改和单页重新生成
items.en: Multi-level revision across the whole deck, a single slide or regeneration

items.zh: 项目会话恢复：保存完整过程并支持导入旧项目继续完善
items.en: Session recovery that preserves the complete workflow for later continuation

items.zh: 可视化 AI 日志：显示生成和修改状态，减少长任务中的不确定感
items.en: Visible AI logs that expose generation and revision status during long-running work

items.zh: 为保证可编辑性，SVG 暂不支持复杂 CSS、滤镜、外部图片和部分高级 SVG 功能
items.en: To preserve editability, SVG currently excludes complex CSS, filters, external images and some advanced features

items.zh: 复杂路径转换为 PowerPoint 自定义几何时仍可能出现细节差异
items.en: Complex paths may still differ when converted to PowerPoint custom geometry

items.zh: 当前重叠检测使用文本框边界估算，仍可能误判或漏判
items.en: Overlap detection estimates text bounds and may still produce false positives or misses

items.zh: 尚未支持图片等不同格式的文件导入
items.en: Image and other file-format imports are not yet supported

items.zh: 当前 PPT 风格仍不可调，同一会话中的风格需要保持一致
items.en: Presentation style is not yet adjustable and must remain consistent within a session

titleZh: 科研证据链插件：当前实现与版本演进
titleEn: Research Evidence Tracker: Implementation and Evolution
summaryZh: 为 OpenClaw 科研 Agent 增加可检查、可追踪、可复现的全文证据审计能力，并透明保留失败与阻塞。
summaryEn: A full-text evidence audit layer for OpenClaw research agents that remains inspectable, traceable and reproducible while preserving failures and blockers.
coverAltZh: Evidence Tracker 的论文身份核对、全文检索、Claim 核验和审计报告流程
coverAltEn: Evidence Tracker workflow: paper identity checks, full-text evidence retrieval, claim review and an auditable report

blocks.zh: 项目的目标不是让 Agent 写出“看起来专业”的报告，而是让每一条科研结论都能够被检查、追踪和复现。
blocks.en: The project is not designed merely to make an agent produce a professional-looking report. Its purpose is to make every research claim inspectable, traceable and reproducible.

items.zh: 区分 Agent 推理与真实材料中的直接证据
items.en: Separate agent reasoning from direct evidence in source material

items.zh: 验证引用论文是否真实存在、身份是否正确
items.en: Verify that cited papers exist and have the correct identity

items.zh: 打开上传 PDF 和外部论文全文，检查 Claim 是否被原文支持
items.en: Open uploaded and external PDFs and test claims against the full text

items.zh: 为每条 Claim 提供来源、页码、证据片段、支持度和理由
items.en: Attach source, page, passage, support level and reasoning to every claim

items.zh: 保留错误、证据不足与下载阻塞，不允许为了美化报告而替换失败证据
items.en: Preserve errors, weak evidence and download blockers instead of laundering failures

blocks.zh: OpenClaw / DeepSeek Agent 负责阅读源论文、检索候选文献、提出三个研究 Idea 并拆分 Claim；evidence-tracker 插件负责论文身份管理、真实全文下载、证据定位、独立判定与报告生成。搜索结果、摘要和 Agent 写入的 Context 只能作为线索，不能直接成为 GREEN 证据。
blocks.en: The OpenClaw / DeepSeek agent reads the source paper, discovers candidates, proposes three ideas and decomposes claims. The evidence tracker owns paper identity, full-text retrieval, passage location, independent judgment and reporting. Search results, abstracts and agent-written context are clues only; they cannot become GREEN evidence by themselves.

blocks.zh: 用户通过 QQBot 上传 PDF，并用简单提示词启动任务。Agent 定位原始上传文件、启动 evidence session、阅读研究目标与局限、检索外部英文论文、生成三个新 Idea、拆成原子 Claim，再逐条调用插件。
blocks.en: A user uploads a PDF through QQBot and starts the task with a simple request. The agent locates the original upload, starts an evidence session, reads goals and limitations, searches external English papers, creates three new ideas, decomposes them into atomic claims and calls the plugin claim by claim.

items.zh: start_evidence_tracking：启动会话并解析源 PDF
items.en: start_evidence_tracking: start a session and parse the source PDF

items.zh: search_literature：发现外部学术文献
items.en: search_literature: discover external academic literature

items.zh: record_citation：记录原子 Claim 与来源类型
items.en: record_citation: record an atomic claim and source type

items.zh: verify_evidence_chain：核验真实全文证据
items.en: verify_evidence_chain: verify evidence against real full text

items.zh: generate_evidence_report：生成透明审计报告
items.en: generate_evidence_report: generate a transparent audit report

items.zh: get_session_status：检查会话状态
items.en: get_session_status: inspect session status

blocks.zh: 发现阶段优先使用 evidence-tracker、paper-search、scientify 的 arXiv / OpenAlex 等专业学术检索能力。发现器只负责扩大候选覆盖率，最终判定必须由 evidence-tracker 独立完成。
blocks.en: Discovery favors dedicated academic tools such as evidence-tracker, paper-search and scientify’s arXiv / OpenAlex capabilities. Discoverers increase candidate coverage; the tracker still makes the final independent judgment.

sections.headingZh: 一次完整任务的十个步骤
sections.headingEn: Ten steps in a complete task

blocks.zh: 1. 启动证据链会话
blocks.en: 1. Start the evidence session

blocks.zh: start_evidence_tracking 必须接收 source_paper、source_pdf_path 和 idea_title。插件立即逐页解析上传 PDF；解析成功后才能继续。新 session 会关闭上一个活动会话、清理上次全文缓存，并重新执行外部检索，避免证据串线。
blocks.en: start_evidence_tracking requires source_paper, source_pdf_path and idea_title. The plugin immediately parses the uploaded PDF page by page. A new session closes the previous one, clears full-text caches and repeats external searches to prevent evidence leakage across tasks.

blocks.zh: 2. 发现外部文献
blocks.en: 2. Discover external literature

blocks.zh: search_literature 并行查询 arXiv、PubMed、Europe PMC、OpenAlex、Crossref、Semantic Scholar 和 DBLP。查询无结果、API 超时或限流都不等价于“论文不存在”。
blocks.en: search_literature queries arXiv, PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar and DBLP in parallel. No result, timeout or rate limit is not proof that a paper does not exist.

blocks.zh: 3. 注册、去重与身份隔离
blocks.en: 3. Register, deduplicate and isolate identities

blocks.zh: 统一注册表保存标题、作者、年份、期刊或会议、DOI、arXiv ID、PMID / PMCID、数据库命中、候选 PDF、下载记录、全文 SHA256 和身份冲突。canonical_id 优先使用 DOI、arXiv ID、PMID、PMCID，最后才回退到规范化标题哈希。强标识符冲突时禁止合并。
blocks.en: A unified registry stores titles, authors, year, venue, DOI, arXiv ID, PMID / PMCID, database hits, candidate PDFs, download attempts, full-text SHA256 and identity conflicts. canonical_id prefers DOI, arXiv ID, PMID and PMCID before falling back to a normalized-title hash. Conflicting strong identifiers are never merged.

blocks.zh: 4. 生成 Idea 并拆分 Claim
blocks.en: 4. Generate ideas and decompose claims

blocks.zh: Idea 可以来自源论文的 limitation、future work、失败案例、未覆盖场景、性能瓶颈、baseline、外部新方法、跨领域迁移或 Agent 的合理推理。但 Idea 本身不是证据；一条 Claim 只能表达一个结论并对应一篇论文，组合 Claim 会被拆分。
blocks.en: Ideas may come from limitations, future work, failures, uncovered settings, bottlenecks, baselines, external methods, cross-domain transfer or reasonable agent inference. An idea is not evidence. Each claim must express one conclusion about one paper; compound claims are split.

blocks.zh: 5. 记录 Claim 与来源类型
blocks.en: 5. Record claims and source types

blocks.zh: record_citation 强制指定 uploaded_pdf 或 external_literature，并记录 cited_source、source_url、context、page_hint 和 section_hint。Context 只是检索提示。若 uploaded_pdf Claim 实际引用外部论文，插件会纠正来源类型并重新下载。replace_citation_id 只能修正同一 Claim、同一论文的元数据，不能换 Claim、换论文或洗白失败状态。
blocks.en: record_citation requires uploaded_pdf or external_literature plus cited_source, source_url, context, page_hint and section_hint. Context is only a retrieval hint. If an uploaded_pdf claim actually cites another paper, the plugin corrects the source type and downloads it. replace_citation_id may fix metadata for the same claim and paper but cannot swap claims, papers or failed outcomes.

blocks.zh: 6. 核验上传 PDF
blocks.en: 6. Verify the uploaded PDF

blocks.zh: 插件只使用 session 启动时真实解析的 PDF，不相信 Agent 提供的引句、页码或 Context。它在整篇文档中检索最相关片段，再交给 LLM 做语义蕴含判断，最终输出真实页码、证据片段、召回方式、支持度与理由。
blocks.en: The plugin uses only the PDF actually parsed when the session started. It does not trust agent-supplied quotes, pages or context. It searches the whole document, sends top passages to an LLM for entailment judgment and returns real pages, passages, retrieval method, support and reasoning.

blocks.zh: 7. 核验外部论文
blocks.en: 7. Verify external papers

blocks.zh: 插件先通过 DOI、arXiv、标题和作者年份多源确认论文身份，再尝试 citation URL、arXiv、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar、Unpaywall、Crossref、Europe PMC / PMC、DataCite、HAL、bioRxiv / medRxiv、OpenReview、ACL Anthology、PMLR、CVF、NeurIPS 等合法全文路径。下载后强制检查首页标题、DOI 与 arXiv ID；错误 PDF 会被删除并标记 IDENTITY_CONFLICT。
blocks.en: The tracker first confirms identity from DOI, arXiv, title and author-year signals. It then tries legal full-text paths including citation URLs, arXiv, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Unpaywall, Crossref, Europe PMC / PMC, DataCite, HAL, bioRxiv / medRxiv, OpenReview, ACL Anthology, PMLR, CVF and NeurIPS. Every download must pass first-page title, DOI and arXiv checks; wrong PDFs are deleted and marked IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

blocks.zh: 8. 混合全文检索与语义判断
blocks.en: 8. Hybrid full-text retrieval and semantic judgment

blocks.zh: 逐页文本被切成有重叠的块，再通过 BM25、轻量哈希向量、数值匹配、页码 / 章节提示和 LLM 查询扩展进行多路召回。融合后的片段被判为 ENTAILMENT、PARTIAL、CONTRADICTION 或 NOT_FOUND。这里的向量召回是轻量哈希向量，不是外部 Embedding 模型。
blocks.en: Page text is split into overlapping chunks and retrieved through BM25, lightweight hash vectors, numeric matching, page / section hints and LLM query expansion. Fused candidates are judged as ENTAILMENT, PARTIAL, CONTRADICTION or NOT_FOUND. The vector path uses lightweight hashing, not an external embedding model.

blocks.zh: 9. 确定性规则复核
blocks.en: 9. Deterministic rule review

blocks.zh: LLM 判断之后还会执行通用规则：强证明或强性能语言如果没有同等强度的原文表述，GREEN 降为 YELLOW；Claim 中的精确数值没有出现在全文证据中时同样降级；未经实验验证的新 Idea 不能仅凭类比判绿。小数、百分比和千位分隔数值会作为完整 token 标准化比较，例如 24.06% 不会再被截断为 06%。
blocks.en: After the LLM judgment, deterministic rules downgrade unsupported proof or performance language, missing exact numbers and untested new ideas. Decimal, percentage and thousands-separated values are normalized as complete tokens, so 24.06% is no longer truncated to 06%.

blocks.zh: 10. 输出可审计状态
blocks.en: 10. Emit auditable states

blocks.zh: 最终报告同时保留成功、失败与工程阻塞，确保任何读者都能复查实际证据，而不是只看到被美化的结论。
blocks.en: The final report preserves successes, scientific failures and engineering blockers so readers can inspect the actual evidence instead of a polished subset.

items.zh: GREEN：实际 PDF 直接陈述或实验展示精确 Claim，且结论强度没有超过证据
items.en: GREEN: the real PDF directly states or demonstrates the exact claim without overstatement

items.zh: YELLOW：全文只支持更弱结论、部分关系、方法类比、迁移依据或合理推断
items.en: YELLOW: the full text supports only a weaker conclusion, partial relation, analogy, transfer rationale or inference

items.zh: RED：全文不支持、与 Claim 矛盾、引用错误、严重夸大，或论文身份错误 / 不存在
items.en: RED: the full text does not support the claim, contradicts it, is wrongly cited, overstated or has a false identity

items.zh: BLOCKED：所有配置的下载与重试路径耗尽后仍无法获得可审核全文；它是工程状态，不伪装成科学判断
items.en: BLOCKED: all configured retrieval paths are exhausted without auditable full text; this is an engineering state, not a scientific verdict

blocks.zh: 报告默认生成结构化 Markdown，包含研究 Idea、Claim、Citation、来源类型、实际页码、证据片段、召回方式、支持度、状态与判定理由。RED 与 BLOCKED 必须原样保留。
blocks.en: The report is structured Markdown containing ideas, claims, citations, source types, actual pages, passages, retrieval methods, support, states and reasons. RED and BLOCKED entries must remain unchanged.

items.zh: 混合检索仍以 BM25 和轻量哈希向量为主，尚未接入高质量科学语义 Embedding
items.en: Hybrid retrieval still relies on BM25 and lightweight hash vectors rather than scientific semantic embeddings

items.zh: 扫描版 PDF、复杂双栏、公式和表格可能降低抽取质量
items.en: Scanned PDFs, complex columns, formulas and tables may reduce extraction quality

items.zh: 开放获取路径受站点策略、限流和网络波动影响，真实论文仍可能进入 BLOCKED
items.en: Open-access retrieval is affected by site policy, rate limits and network conditions, so real papers may remain BLOCKED

items.zh: LLM 蕴含判断仍可能误判，因此报告必须保留实际片段、页码和支持度供人工复核
items.en: LLM entailment can still be wrong, so reports must retain passages, pages and support for human review

items.zh: 官方技术页面、代码仓库和数据集需要独立的可信来源类型与审计规则
items.en: Official technical pages, code repositories and datasets need their own trusted-source types and audit rules

blocks.zh: v1：元数据验证原型
blocks.en: v1: Metadata-validation prototype

blocks.zh: v1 注册五个工具，主要通过 DOI、arXiv 与标题确认论文存在，并依据摘要和 LLM 判断 Claim。它不会真正打开上传 PDF，也没有稳定的外部全文核验、明确 source_type、统一注册表或身份冲突处理，因此还不是严格的全文审计系统。
blocks.en: v1 registered five tools and verified paper existence mainly from DOI, arXiv and titles, then judged claims from abstracts and an LLM. It did not open uploaded PDFs, reliably inspect external full text, define source_type or manage a canonical registry and conflicts.

blocks.zh: v2：打通真实交互与 PDF 交付
blocks.en: v2: Real interaction and PDF delivery

blocks.zh: v2 把插件接入本地 OpenClaw 与 QQBot，修复工具不可见和调用不稳定，增加 Markdown → HTML / PDF、Evidence Table、支持度、错误类型和确定性降级规则。但核心仍依赖元数据、摘要与 Agent Context，PDF 证据并未真正全文审核。
blocks.en: v2 connected the plugin to OpenClaw and QQBot, stabilized tool visibility, added Markdown → HTML / PDF, evidence tables, support values, error types and deterministic downgrades. Verification still relied on metadata, abstracts and agent context rather than real full-text review.

blocks.zh: v3：多源检索、Markdown 报告和质量门槛
blocks.en: v3: Multi-source search, Markdown reports and quality gates

blocks.zh: v3 将 search_literature 公开为第六个工具，扩展 Semantic Scholar、OpenAlex、Crossref、Europe PMC、DBLP 和 arXiv fallback，修复 APA / venue / arXiv 标题提取，加入多源身份查找、重试、至少 15 条 Citation 和至少 6 条外部文献的门槛，并改用高质量中文 Markdown。其局限是 PDF 内证据仍受 Agent Context 影响，外部支持关系仍主要基于摘要。
blocks.en: v3 exposed search_literature as a sixth tool, expanded multi-source discovery and arXiv fallback, improved citation parsing, retries and quality gates of at least 15 citations and six external papers, and moved to polished Chinese Markdown. Uploaded evidence still depended too much on context, and external support still leaned on abstracts.

blocks.zh: v4：真实全文证据审计系统
blocks.en: v4: A real full-text evidence audit system

items.zh: 强制解析真实上传 PDF，不再因 Agent 写入页码或 Context 而判绿
items.en: Parse the real uploaded PDF and stop trusting agent-provided pages or context

items.zh: 多源确认外部论文身份，并下载真实 PDF 逐页核验
items.en: Confirm external identity across sources and verify downloaded PDFs page by page

items.zh: 下载后检查首页标题、DOI 与 arXiv，隔离 IDENTITY_CONFLICT
items.en: Validate first-page title, DOI and arXiv and isolate IDENTITY_CONFLICT

items.zh: 用 canonical ID 统一注册与严格去重
items.en: Unify registration and deduplication with canonical IDs

items.zh: 强制 source_type，自动纠正来源身份
items.en: Require source_type and correct mismatched source identity

items.zh: 拆分原子 Claim，禁止替换 Claim / 论文来洗白失败

titleZh: GRA-Flow：面向无任务标签 OOD 图像修复的收益—风险对齐整流流细化
titleEn: GRA-Flow: Gain-Risk Aligned Rectified-Flow Refinement for Task-Free OOD Image Restoration
summaryZh: 在冻结修复骨干和候选生成模型的前提下，研究如何判断额外修正是否有益，以及应该应用多大强度。通过轨迹观测预测方向性收益，在部署时无需干净目标或退化标签。
summaryEn: When does an extra restoration step help, and how strongly should it be applied? GRA-Flow studies this decision with a frozen restorer and proposal, predicting directional benefit from trajectory observations without a clean target or degradation label at inference.
coverAltZh: GRA-Flow 论文图 2：低光和空间雾条件下，候选修正、通道均值、中心化分量与逐像素误差变化的分解。
coverAltEn: Figure 2 from GRA-Flow: image-space correction decomposition under low-light and spatial haze, including channel-mean and centered components and pixelwise error changes.

blocks.zh: 图像修复模型给出的额外修正不一定有效。同一个整流流候选，可能改善某种退化，也可能损害另一种退化下已有的修复结果。因此，除了生成候选图像，还需要判断何时采用它，以及采用多少。
blocks.en: An additional correction is not always helpful. The same rectified-flow proposal can improve one degradation and damage the existing restoration under another. Generating a candidate therefore leaves a second problem: deciding when to use it and how much to apply.

blocks.zh: GRA-Flow 将输出写成冻结基线与候选终点之间的连续插值：Y_out = Y_0 + α(Y_f − Y_0)，其中 α 在 0 与 1 之间。α = 0 保留基线，α = 1 使用完整候选；这个终点动作与轨迹生成时的引导强度是两个不同的量。
blocks.en: GRA-Flow expresses the output as a continuous interpolation between the frozen baseline and proposal endpoint: Y_out = Y_0 + α(Y_f − Y_0), with α between 0 and 1. Zero retains the baseline; one applies the full proposal. This endpoint action is distinct from the guidance scale used to generate the trajectory.

blocks.zh: 平方误差相对基线的变化可以精确写成 ΔMSE(α) = aα² − 2bα。修正能量 a 可以直接观测，而修正方向与基线剩余误差的对齐量 b 依赖未知的干净图像。方法将归一化方向性收益作为预测目标，从而把候选生成与修正决策分开。
blocks.en: The change in squared error relative to the baseline has the exact form ΔMSE(α) = aα² − 2bα. Correction energy a is observable, while alignment b with the remaining baseline error depends on the unknown clean image. Normalized directional benefit becomes the prediction target, separating proposal generation from the correction decision.

items.zh: 从同一次冻结候选生成过程中收集轨迹统计量，不额外求解一条轨迹。
items.en: Collect trajectory statistics during the existing frozen proposal pass, without solving a second trajectory.

items.zh: 在离线训练中结合位置、符号、同一图像的成对退化干预和下尾监督，并按干净图像身份划分数据。
items.en: Combine location, sign, paired-degradation and lower-tail supervision offline, keeping all variants of one clean identity in the same split.

items.zh: 用共享的单侧残差偏移调整收益分数，再解析地选择连续修正强度；推理时不输入干净图像或退化标签。
items.en: Adjust the benefit score with a shared one-sided residual offset, then choose a continuous correction strength analytically. Inference uses neither a clean image nor a degradation label.

blocks.zh: 非有害修正结论以预测下界满足逐样本条件为前提。当前开发阶段的 OOF 残差调整属于经验性校正，需要与独立风险认证区分。
blocks.en: The non-harmful correction result is conditional on a pointwise lower-score requirement. The current OOF residual adjustment is an empirical development procedure and is distinct from independent risk certification.

blocks.zh: 我是这篇手稿的第二作者。我的工作包括冻结骨干下的图像修复与泛化研究，以及修复候选生成模块的条件设计。
blocks.en: I am the second author of this manuscript. My work includes image restoration and generalization with a frozen backbone, and conditioning design for the restoration proposal module.

items.zh: 参与设计对编码器特征进行池化、归一化和投影的条件模块，将其转换为注意力上下文向量。
items.en: Co-designed a conditioning module that pools, normalizes and projects encoder features into an attention context vector.

items.zh: 提出轻量 RGB 退化编码器，并完成相关消融实验、结果分析和论文写作工作。
items.en: Proposed a lightweight RGB degradation encoder, implemented related ablations, analyzed results and contributed to manuscript preparation.

blocks.zh: 论文将开发集诊断与冻结策略的新偏移评估分开，并明确它们不能替代独立风险认证。在八种新合成退化偏移的面板上，τ = 0.05 的冻结策略将宏平均 PSNR 从 24.09 dB 提高到 24.29 dB，修正覆盖率为 14.9%，没有观测到已执行修正增加 MSE 的样本。
blocks.en: The manuscript separates development diagnostics, fresh-shift evaluation of frozen policies and independent risk certification. Across eight fresh synthetic degradation shifts, the frozen τ = 0.05 policy increases macro PSNR from 24.09 dB to 24.29 dB at 14.9% correction coverage, with no observed MSE-increasing executed corrections.

blocks.zh: 这些结果对应论文指定的测试面板，不能外推成任意未知退化上的安全保证。在 UIEB 和 LOL-v2-real 的真实退化边界测试中，两种冻结策略均拒绝全部候选并保留基线，没有带来新的修复增益。完整协议、对照实验和局限见论文。
blocks.en: These results apply to the specified evaluation panel and do not establish a safety guarantee for arbitrary unseen degradations. On the UIEB and LOL-v2-real boundary panels, both frozen policies reject every proposal and retain the baseline, producing no new restoration gain. The PDF contains the full protocol, controls and limitations.

titleZh: RECAST：面向冻结骨干全能图像修复的受控残差传输
titleEn: Controlled Residual Transport for Frozen-Backbone All-in-One Image Restoration
summaryZh: 通过条件整流流学习从骨干预测到干净图像的残差传输，再结合尺度一致性融合与多视图平均，控制修正幅度并细化已有修复结果。
summaryEn: RECAST learns conditional residual transport from frozen backbone predictions to clean targets, then combines scale-consistency fusion and view averaging to control the correction applied to the existing restoration.
coverAltZh: RECAST 论文图 1：冻结骨干上的残差传输训练、全分辨率与半分辨率推理、尺度一致性融合和多视图平均。
coverAltEn: Figure 1 from RECAST: residual-transport training, full- and half-resolution inference, scale-consistency fusion and view averaging on a frozen backbone.

blocks.zh: 全能图像修复希望用一个模型处理多种退化，但未知退化类型和强度仍然会带来泛化困难。RECAST 复用预训练骨干，只训练附加的残差细化模块，研究如何在不更新骨干权重的前提下改善修复结果。
blocks.en: All-in-one image restoration uses a shared model for multiple degradations, but unseen degradation types and severities remain difficult. RECAST reuses a pretrained backbone and trains an additional residual refiner to improve restoration while keeping the backbone weights fixed.

blocks.zh: 方法将“预测怎样修正”与“各位置应用多大修正”分开：条件整流流负责生成候选残差，尺度一致性负责控制其空间幅度。
blocks.en: The method separates predicting a correction from deciding its strength at each location: conditional rectified flow generates a candidate residual, while scale consistency controls its spatial magnitude.

items.zh: 残差传输：用骨干预测与配对干净图像之间的线性路径训练速度场，骨干和条件编码器保持冻结。
items.en: Residual transport: train a velocity field along a linear path between backbone predictions and paired clean targets, while keeping the backbone and conditioning encoders frozen.

items.zh: 跨退化潜在插值：训练时插值不同退化样本的条件特征，原样本的图像路径、任务条件和残差目标保持不变。
items.en: Cross-degradation latent interpolation: interpolate conditioning features during training while retaining the original image path, task condition and residual target.

items.zh: 尺度一致性融合：共享速度场分别处理全分辨率与半分辨率预测，利用两者的不一致程度对全分辨率残差加权。
items.en: Scale-consistency fusion: use a shared velocity field at full and half resolution, and weight the full-resolution residual using disagreement between the two candidates.

items.zh: 多视图平均：在八种旋转与翻转视图中分别细化，再进行逆变换和平均。
items.en: View averaging: refine eight rotated and reflected views separately, then invert the transforms and average the outputs.

blocks.zh: 尺度差异越大，局部残差权重越小。这个权重限制了输出偏离对应骨干预测的幅度，但本身不保证重建误差一定降低。
blocks.en: Greater cross-scale disagreement reduces the local residual weight. This bounds the displacement from the corresponding backbone prediction, but does not by itself guarantee a reduction in reconstruction error.

blocks.zh: 论文评估去雾、去雨、去噪、去模糊和低光增强，并在室外雾、JPEG、雨滴和雪等分布偏移上检验完整流程。主要对照是单视图骨干，完整方法同时包含残差细化、尺度融合和八视图平均。
blocks.en: The paper evaluates dehazing, deraining, denoising, deblurring and low-light enhancement, together with shifts involving outdoor haze, JPEG, raindrops and snow. The main comparison is against a single-view backbone; the complete method includes residual refinement, scale fusion and eight-view averaging.

blocks.zh: 因此，完整流程的提升需要与单个模块的贡献区分。任务条件和融合参数按数据集配置，记录中的评估包含目标基准参数扫描；这些结果对应论文中明确列出的设置。
blocks.en: Complete-pipeline gains should therefore be distinguished from the contribution of any individual component. Task conditions and fusion parameters are configured by dataset, and the recorded evaluations include target-benchmark parameter sweeps. The results describe the settings specified in the paper.

blocks.zh: 我是这篇论文的第三作者。稿件已投稿 2026 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence（ICCBD+AI 2026）。上方 PDF 包含完整方法、实验表格与分析。
blocks.en: I am the third author of this paper. The manuscript has been submitted to the 2026 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICCBD+AI 2026). The PDF above contains the complete method, experimental tables and analyses.
